title: Design System: 검색 API 진단 콘솔

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Existing button color feedback; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary action
components.css: .ds-primary{font:16px/1.65 system-ui, -apple-system, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;background:var(--accent,#245ec7);color:#fff;border:1px solid var(--accent,#245ec7);border-radius:6px;padding:0.6rem 1.2rem;min-height:46px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s;}.ds-primary:hover{background:#184898;}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #527dde;outline-offset:3px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none;}}

components.name: Text field
components.css: .ds-label{font:16px/1.65 system-ui, -apple-system, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;display:block;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink,#20252d);}.ds-input{font:16px/1.65 system-ui, -apple-system, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;display:block;margin-top:6px;background:white;color:var(--ink,#20252d);border:1px solid #8b96a4;border-radius:6px;padding:0.5rem 0.6rem;min-height:42px;caret-color:var(--accent,#245ec7);}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #527dde;outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Current navigation
components.css: .ds-current{font:16px/1.65 system-ui, -apple-system, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;padding:12px 20px;border:0;border-radius:0;border-bottom:3px solid var(--accent,#245ec7);background:#fff;color:var(--accent,#245ec7);font-weight:600;}.ds-current:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #527dde;outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Supporting container
components.css: .ds-support{font:16px/1.65 system-ui, -apple-system, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#20252d);border:1px solid var(--line,#d7dde5);border-radius:8px;padding:14px;background:#fff;}

components.name: Empty state
components.css: .ds-empty{font:16px/1.65 system-ui, -apple-system, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;color:var(--muted,#535e6c);}

components.name: Record row
components.css: .ds-row{font:16px/1.65 system-ui, -apple-system, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;padding:20px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#d7dde5);color:var(--ink,#20252d);}.ds-row p{color:var(--muted,#535e6c);}

narrative.overview: White request controls and graphite JSON surfaces distinguish input from response. Blue marks execution and the selected response tab. Recent requests and popularity follow the main experiment; contract details remain expandable reference material.
donts: Do not imply production success from synthetic state.
Do not claim visual verification without rendering.
